```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = F, message = F)
library(igraph)
library(intergraph)
library(network)
library(sna)
library(statnet)
library(statnetWeb)
library(circlize)
library(SportsAnalytics270)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(UserNetR)
```


```{r}
post_soviet_countries <- c("Armenia", "Russia", "Ukraine", "Georgia", "Belarus",
                           "Azerbaijan", "Moldova", "Latvia", "Estonia")

eurovision_1 <- read.csv("eurovision.csv") %>%
  filter(Duplicate != "x")

eurovision_ussr <- eurovision_1 %>%
  filter(From.country %in% post_soviet_countries, 
         To.country %in% post_soviet_countries, 
         From.country != To.country ) %>%
  group_by(From.country, To.country) %>%
  summarise(count = n(),
            mean_points = mean(Points),
            total_points = sum(Points)
            ) 


ussr_igraph <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(as.matrix(eurovision_ussr[,1:2]), directed = T)

ussr_igraph <- set_edge_attr(ussr_igraph, "mean.points", value = eurovision_ussr$mean_points)
ussr_igraph <- set_edge_attr(ussr_igraph, "count", value = eurovision_ussr$count)
ussr_igraph <- set_edge_attr(ussr_igraph, "total.points", value = eurovision_ussr$total_points)
```

```{r}
l <- layout_in_circle(ussr_igraph)

plot(ussr_igraph, layout = l, edge.arrow.mode = 3, 
     edge.width = E(ussr_igraph)$"count",edge.curved = T,
     label = V(ussr_igraph))

```

```{r}
ussr_count <- E(ussr_igraph)$"count"
ussr_count <- (ussr_count - min(ussr_count))/ 
  (max(ussr_count) - min(ussr_count))
ussr_count[which(ussr_count == 0, arr.ind = T)] <- 0.0000001
ussr_igraph <- set_edge_attr(ussr_igraph, "scaled.count", value = ussr_count)


plot(ussr_igraph, layout = l, edge.arrow.mode = 3, 
     edge.width = E(ussr_igraph)$"scaled.count",edge.curved = T,
     label = V(ussr_igraph))
```


```{r}
ussr_total_points <- E(ussr_igraph)$"total.points"
ussr_total_points <- (ussr_total_points - min(ussr_total_points))/ 
  (max(ussr_total_points) - min(ussr_total_points))
ussr_total_points[which(ussr_total_points == 0, arr.ind = T)] <- 0.0000001
ussr_igraph <- set_edge_attr(ussr_igraph, "scaled.total.points", value = ussr_total_points)


plot(ussr_igraph, layout = l, edge.arrow.mode = 3, 
     edge.width = E(ussr_igraph)$"scaled.total.points" * 3,edge.curved = T,
     label = V(ussr_igraph))
```



```{r}
eurovision <- read.csv("eurovision.csv") %>%
  filter(Duplicate != "x", From.country != To.country ) %>%
  select(-Duplicate) %>%
  group_by(From.country, To.country)%>%
  summarise(count = n(),
          mean_points = mean(Points),
          total_points = sum(Points)
          ) 

evs_igraph <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(as.matrix(eurovision[,1:2]), directed = T)
evs_igraph <- set_edge_attr(evs_igraph, "count", value = eurovision$count)
evs_igraph <- set_edge_attr(evs_igraph, "mean.points", value = eurovision$mean_points)
evs_igraph <- set_edge_attr(evs_igraph, "total_points", value = eurovision$total_points)
```


```{r}
(density <- igraph::edge_density(evs_igraph, loops = F))
(igraph::reciprocity(evs_igraph))
sort(igraph::degree(evs_igraph, mode = "all", normalized = T), decreasing = T)
sort(igraph::closeness(evs_igraph, mode = "all", 
                       weights = E(evs_igraph)$sum.points, normalized = T), decreasing = T)

sort(page_rank(evs_igraph)$vector, decreasing = T)
```

```{r, fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
undirected <- as.undirected(evs_igraph, mode = c("collapse"))
com <- fastgreedy.community(undirected)
sizes(com)

plot(com, evs_igraph)
```
